notes: SERIOUS TRANSCRIPTION ERROR IN PEPlife2. Table 3's 'Sex' column has three levels - male, female, and P - where P is the significance of the male-vs-female comparison, per the footnote 'P value: independent t test, female vs male'. PEPlife2 read that statistics row as a third experimental group and transcribed the p-values 0.57, 0.65 and 0.22 as elimination half-lives in hours (PEPlife2 IDs 4577, 4580, 4583, all labelled '(P) SD rats plasma'). They are not half-lives and have been excluded via CURATED_NOT_A_HALF_LIFE in subset_in_vivo_half_life.py. The four genuine values PEPlife2 does carry (0.30, 0.28, 0.31, 0.32 h) are correct; it omits the 0.2 mmol/kg pair (0.30, 0.32 h), which duplicate values already present. Note also that the half-life here is of Gd(III), measured by ICP-MS, not of the intact peptide - the paper separately reports that the ZD2 peptide itself degrades in rat plasma with a t1/2 of 1.63 h ex vivo. The body does not print the peptide sequence.
